guide.effect.chilli_biltong: For {s} seconds your gun keeps firing while you hold, and the ammo never runs out.
guide.effect.boeretroos: For {s} seconds everything moves at {speed} speed.
guide.effect.bush_buckshot: Your next {n} shells spread {x}× wider, so a bunched flock is easier to hit.
guide.effect.meerkat_spotter: For {s} seconds a meerkat keeps watch and rings the farm's hidden secrets.
guide.effect.blitslaai: For {s} seconds every reload takes only {pct} % of the time.
guide.effect.oupa_laai: For {s} seconds Oupa loads for you: an empty gun reloads by itself, and a gun loaded shell by shell tops up after {idle} s without a shot.
guide.effect.rooikol: For {s} seconds your rifle aims through a red dot instead of its sight: no zooming in or out, it is ready the moment you press, and the time between shots is {pct} % of normal. No magnification, so far birds stay small — they can still be hit.
guide.effect.voorlaaier: An old muzzle-loader: {n} huge blasts of {p} pellets each, with a slow {r} s ramrod reload.
guide.effect.mielie_masjien: For {s} seconds hold to spray a fast stream of maize kernels, with no reloading.
guide.tip.chilli_biltong: Hold fire and sweep slowly across the flock.
guide.tip.boeretroos: Slow birds are easy birds: go for the far ones and the flyers.
guide.tip.bush_buckshot: Wait for birds to bunch up: one wide shell can bag a few.
guide.tip.meerkat_spotter: Pan around quickly: the rings show where the secrets are.
guide.tip.blitslaai: Shoot freely: an empty gun is full again in a blink.
guide.tip.oupa_laai: Keep shooting: Oupa has the reloading covered.
guide.tip.rooikol: Point and shoot: near and mid birds fall fast; far ones are small, so take your time on them.
guide.tip.voorlaaier: Save each blast for a big, tight flock.
guide.tip.mielie_masjien: Hold and sweep: it never needs a reload.

guide.baboon.raid_fruit: Bobbejaan in the fruit tree! Shoo!
guide.baboon.raid_tap: He's going for the tap! There goes my water!
guide.baboon.raid_throw: Watch out, he's throwing fruit at the birds!
guide.baboon.raid_moon: Oh no, man! He's showing us his backside!
guide.baboon.bagged: Got him! One bobbejaan less in the mielies.
guide.baboon.mother: Not the mother with her baby, man!

guide.reenbui.note: After the first summer rain the winged termites pour out of the ground; every bird comes down to feast.

guide.harvest.fixed: Fence is fixed! Well done, everyone!

guide.brakkie.fetched: Good boy, Brakkie! Bring it here.
guide.brakkie.title: Come, Brakkie! We're going hunting.

guide.journal.habitat.namibie: Watch the weaver colonies in Namibië for a colourful pair.

guide.journal.species.galago.name: Bushbaby
guide.journal.species.galago.fact: Bushbabies are nocturnal primates. By day they rest in sheltered places such as tree hollows.
guide.journal.species.galago.note: Oupa: Quiet eyes find the best neighbours.
guide.journal.species.squirrel.name: Tree squirrel
guide.journal.species.squirrel.fact: This southern African squirrel mostly lives in trees, but also searches the ground for fallen food.
guide.journal.species.squirrel.note: Oupa: That little fellow knows every branch.
guide.journal.species.owl.name: Barn owl
guide.journal.species.owl.fact: Soft feathers quiet a barn owl’s flight, helping it listen for small prey.
guide.journal.species.owl.note: Oupa: Let our quiet neighbour rest.
guide.journal.species.hornbill.name: Yellow-billed hornbill
guide.journal.species.hornbill.fact: The nesting female seals herself into a tree cavity, leaving a narrow opening for food.
guide.journal.species.hornbill.note: Oupa: A good home is worth looking after.
guide.journal.species.buffaloWeaver.name: Red-billed buffalo weaver
guide.journal.species.buffaloWeaver.fact: Buffalo weavers build large stick nests with separate chambers.
guide.journal.species.weaver.name: Sociable weaver
guide.journal.species.weaver.fact: Sociable weavers share a huge nest containing many separate chambers.
guide.journal.species.weaver.note: Oupa: A whole village in one tree!
guide.journal.species.falcon.name: Pygmy falcon
guide.journal.species.falcon.fact: Pygmy falcons often use chambers in weaver nests instead of building a nest of their own.
guide.journal.species.lovebirds.name: Rosy-faced lovebirds
guide.journal.species.lovebirds.fact: Rosy-faced lovebirds can use the sheltered chambers of sociable-weaver nests.
guide.journal.species.lovebirds.note: Oupa: There is always room for a little colour.
guide.journal.tip.steady: Oupa: Wait for a clear bird and settle your aim. Build accuracy with nearby birds.
guide.journal.tip.reload: Oupa: Reload while the birds move away, so the belt is ready when they settle.
guide.journal.tip.flock: Oupa: Watch a flock’s alarm and run. Time the flush, then follow it for wing shots.
guide.journal.tip.distance: Oupa: Far birds are small targets. Try the training range and a rifle with a sight.
guide.journal.tip.weapon: Oupa: Match the gun to the distance. Test one change at a time at the range.
guide.journal.nudge.steady: Oupa: Start with a calm, nearby shot.
guide.journal.nudge.reload: Oupa: Reload while the flock moves away.
guide.journal.nudge.flock: Oupa: Watch the alarm, then time the flush.
guide.journal.nudge.distance: Oupa: Try a sighted rifle at the range.
guide.journal.nudge.weapon: Oupa: Try one weapon change at the range.
